title: Drift attribution probe and triage playbook: correlate eval regressions to infra, quantization, and prompt variants
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build an operational playbook and lightweight automation to attribute observed regressions in production-quality evals to one (or a combination) of: 1) upstream model weight/version changes, 2) quantization/format conversion artifacts, 3) serving runtime kernel/optimizer changes, 4) prompted input distribution shift (prompt drift), or 5) routing/fallback policy mismatches. The output is: a reproducible lab experiment template, a triage dashboard wireframe, alerting thresholds and an incident runbook that triggers canary rollback or targeted re-routing to fallback variants.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible repro template (notebook + workload config) that reproduces a measured regression with >=90% agreement to production metric delta
Dashboard prototype that links eval deltas to: model version, quantization profile, runtime binary hash, route policy, and example request samples
Automated A/B job that runs nightly across top-5 customer prompt buckets and emits a drift attribution report to the alerts queue
Clear rollback/mitigation decision tree and a Slack alert playbook for on-call with templated customer-facing language
milestones: M1: Kickoff & artifact inventory (confluence + eval suites) - 2026-02-24
M2: Instrumentation plan + lightweight schema for trace headers and kernel tags - 2026-03-05
M3: Lab repro templates and initial A/B runs across model/quant variants - 2026-03-12
M4: Dashboard prototype + triage decision tree review - 2026-03-20
M5: Nightly automation + alerting wired into on-call runbook - 2026-03-28
tasks: Collect canonical prompt set: 12 representative prompts per vertical + edge cases from customer incidents
Define evaluation signals: semantic-similarity delta, instruction-consistency score, hallucination flags, and latency impact
Add runtime metadata to trace: model_hash, quant_profile, kernel_tag, gpu_kernel_hash, and routing_policy_id
Implement nightly A/B runner that spins up model variants (float16, q4_0, q4_1) and captures per-prompt outputs
Build lightweight repro notebook that can pin: model binary, quant file, runtime docker tag and prompt set
Design triage dashboard (Looker/Console) linking delta -> probable root cause with confidence score
notes: We must avoid creating heavyweight workflows; focus on fast, incremental signals (first 24h) rather than perfect proof
This playbook is meant to feed both SRE/Oncall and Product incident response teams
Prioritize customer cases where SLA breaches intersect with quality regressions
risks: False positives from semantic-similarity metrics — must pair with human triage for first 3 incidents
Data retention and PII when saving example requests for repro — mask or substitute before storing
Resource cost for nightly A/B runs if we test too many variants—start with top-3 model flavors
communication_plan: Weekly sync with Eng reliability lead (Tuesday 10am PT)
Biweekly stakeholder readout with Sales/CS for customer-impacting regressions
Runbook templates committed to shared ops Slack channel and confluence page
